rules: no random animations — every motion bound to telemetry
idle systems must visibly idle (no animation, optional muted pulse)
stale systems must display stale_warning (orange tint)
lift cars lerp toward current_floor; trail brightens during motion
openclaw orb lerps Y toward current_floor; orbits at fixed angular velocity
event packets only spawn when intercom telemetry contains new packets
cadence pulse only triggers when eqsb_cadence.tick_count increments
